description: Public edition: Industrial networks that recover waste heat and reuse energy wherever technically and economically feasible.
body:
Closed-Loop Industrial Energy Civilization. Industrial networks that recover waste heat and reuse energy wherever technically and economically feasible.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 48 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Energy Beyond Conventional Infrastructure". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: demonstrated. Waste-heat recovery and industrial symbiosis operate commercially (Kalundborg since the 1970s).

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Closed-Loop Industrial Energy Civilization - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Industrial networks that recover waste heat and reuse energy wherever technically and economically feasible.
body:
Known science foundations of Closed-Loop Industrial Energy Civilization.

Kalundborg's industrial symbiosis exchanges steam, heat, and materials among plants. Waste-heat recovery generates power in cement and steel plants. District heating reuses industrial heat in Scandinavia. Pinch analysis optimizes heat exchange networks. Full closed-loop civilization is aspirational, but the unit operations are demonstrated.

Key quantity check (Industrial waste heat in EJ per year / global primary energy in EJ): computed ratio 0.05 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Closed-Loop Industrial Energy Civilization - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: Industrial networks that recover waste heat and reuse energy wherever technically and economically feasible.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Closed-Loop Industrial Energy Civilization.

Low-grade heat has limited uses. Co-locating industries for symbiosis is organizationally hard. Retrofitting existing plants is capital-intensive.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 2.3 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is recovery efficiency vs symbiosis parks worldwide at 2.3 orders of magnitude (symbiosis parks worldwide larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

description: Public edition: Industrial networks that recover waste heat and reuse energy wherever technically and economically feasible.
body:
Unresolved problems for Closed-Loop Industrial Energy Civilization, in priority order (research burden index 12, 0 blocking):

Organizational barriers (severity 2/3, tractability 1/3; priority 6).

Economics of low-grade heat (severity 2/3, tractability 2/3; priority 4).

Retrofit capital (severity 2/3, tractability 3/3; priority 2).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
